thread:
marta: Heads up — multiple customers filing in. After the routing cutover this morning the latency console is missing the p95/p99 traces (p50 and avg are fine). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency?env=prod. Tickets reference orgs: org-alpha, org-zen, org-orchid.

ops-bot: Deploy event: routing-cutover v2.3.1 promoted to prod by ci-bot at 1962103000 (release notes: routing service rewrite).

alejandro: On it. Can you paste one of the customer screenshots or the org id so I can query raw metrics? Any errors visible in the app?

marta: Screenshot attached in ticket (not in thread). Example org: org-alpha. Customers say app latency unchanged, just the dashboard lines (p95/p99) show as flat/absent.

liz: I queried the metrics aggregator for org-alpha. Raw collector still emits percentile series, but the aggregate view panel isn't picking them up. Quick check: `curl -s "https://metrics-internal.redwood.ai/query?org=org-alpha&q=series_list" | jq '.series | map(.name)'` returns the p50 series but not the p95/p99 aliases.

alejandro: That aligns with a transform rename I saw in the canary config this week. There's a transform that renames `quantile` tag -> `pctile` to unify series names. If the transform ran but the dashboard expects the old tag, panels would lose their match.

liz: I pulled recent aggregator logs (snippet):
```
metrics-aggregator[2026-03-17T10:12:34Z] INFO rename_transform: applied rename quantile->pctile for series redwood.request.duration
metrics-aggregator[2026-03-17T10:12:35Z] WARN panel-match: series alias not found for panel_id=latency-pctile-panel, expected tags: [quantile]
metrics-aggregator[2026-03-17T10:12:36Z] ERROR series-drop: no-matching-alias for quantile=0.99
```
That suggests the transform rename landed but dashboards weren't updated to use `pctile` tag.

alejandro: Can you check the S3 transform config? `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-configs/metrics/transforms/prod.yml -` I see this recent change on line ~122: `- rename: { from: "quantile", to: "pctile" }` and a note "standardize percentiles". We forgot to add an alias for backwards compatibility.

sam: This was my change in the metrics transform PR — I assumed dashboards would accept the new tag. My bad. I can push a compatibility mapping immediately. Will add an alias so queries matching `quantile` also match `pctile`.

sam: Patching now — PR -> https://git.internal.redwood/metrics/transform/merge_requests/412 (adds alias mapping `quantile_alias: pctile`). Rolling hotfix to prod. ETA ~15m.

ops-bot: Hotfix deploy started at 1962103600 by sam.

alejandro: Once the mapping is applied we'll need to reindex the last 30m of aggregated series or the dashboard panel will still miss older series. I can trigger reindex job: `kubectl exec -it metrics-reindexer -- /reindex --since 30m --org org-alpha`

liz: Reindex kicked off for affected orgs. Job logs show re-emitting percentile series with both tags.

ops-bot: Hotfix deploy succeeded at 1962103700.

sam: Patch applied and alias mapping confirmed in prod transforms. Please verify dashboards.

liz: Confirmed: p95/p99 lines reappeared for org-alpha and we have confirmation from two customers. Panel queries now match both `quantile` and `pctile`.

marta: Notifying CS to close customer tickets and adding follow-up action: add dashboard compatibility test to canary checklist and a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:

alejandro: Filed follow-up issue: METRICS-748 add alias test + reindex automation.

marta: Thanks team. We'll leave this thread open until all tickets closed.
